fml.menu.mods.info.description.realmcoun: Fantasy elections, candidates, secret ballots and mandates. Works alone; optional Crónicas RP integration.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.no_election: There is no election yet. Once the council calls one, its dates and candidates will appear here.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.eligible: The electoral roll is fixed when the election opens. Requires %s minutes of play; operators may enrol players during nominations.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.voted: Your ballot is recorded for this round.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.ready: You are on the electoral roll.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.not_eligible: You are not on this election’s roll.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.urn: Read the proposals. To vote, visit a ballot box during voting. Other players cannot see your choice.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.no_candidates: There are no candidates yet. Nominations open during the first election phase.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.hidden_results: Counts stay sealed until voting ends. Only participation is published during voting.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.no_governor: The governor’s seat awaits an election result.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.await_oath: Elected · awaiting the oath at an oath desk
gui.realmcouncil.hint.no_decisions: No decisions have been published yet.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.no_history: Previous elections will appear in this record.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.proposals: What will you do for the realm?
gui.realmcouncil.hint.voting_closed: Voting has not opened or has already ended. Check the ledger for the current phase.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.confirm_vote: Confirm carefully. Your ballot is final for this round. Your choice will not be shown to other players.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.oath: I, %s, accept the duty to serve the council, uphold the realm’s rules and make my decisions public.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.public_decision: This message will be visible to everyone.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.withdraw: You will withdraw from this election. You may enter again while nominations are open.
error.realmcouncil.text: Invalid text. Motto: 3–80 characters; proposals: 10–1,000; decision: 10–500.
error.realmcouncil.duration: Duration must be between 1 and 525,600 minutes.
error.realmcouncil.term_active: The current term has not ended.
error.realmcouncil.roll_locked: The electoral roll can only be changed during nominations.
error.realmcouncil.unknown_player: This player has not been registered with the council.
error.realmcouncil.nominations_closed: Nominations are closed for this action.
error.realmcouncil.not_eligible: You are not on this election’s electoral roll.
error.realmcouncil.candidate_limit: The candidate limit has been reached.
error.realmcouncil.symbol: Choose one of the available symbols.
error.realmcouncil.not_candidate: You have no candidacy in this election.
error.realmcouncil.stale: The election or round changed. Open the ballot again.
error.realmcouncil.already_voted: You have already voted in this round.
error.realmcouncil.candidate: That candidate is not running in this round.
error.realmcouncil.no_election: There is no active election for this action.
error.realmcouncil.not_winner: Only the winner can take this oath.
error.realmcouncil.already_sworn: You have already taken the oath.
error.realmcouncil.not_governor: This action requires a sworn-in governor.
error.realmcouncil.decision_limit: This term already has 20 published decisions.
error.realmcouncil.station: Approach the correct notice board, ballot box or oath desk and interact with it again.
error.realmcouncil.too_fast: Wait a moment before repeating the action.
message.realmcouncil.welcome: An election for %s is running. Interact with a notice board to read the council book.
message.realmcouncil.created: The council called an election for %s.
message.realmcouncil.phase_changed: The election phase changed. Check the council ledger.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.admin_create_locke: The previous election and any active term must end before another election can be created.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.admin_roll_locked: The electoral roll can only be changed during nominations.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.admin_no_players: No players found. This list contains players who have joined the world since the mod was installed.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.admin_advance: This ends the current phase immediately. If voting is open, the recorded votes will be counted; a tie may start another round.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.admin_cancel: The election will end without electing a winner. Voting and nominations will no longer be available.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.admin_endterm: The term ends immediately. The governor can no longer publish decisions. A new election may then be called.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.admin_exclude: This player will be excluded from this election’s electoral roll. Their candidacy, if any, will also be removed.
gui.realmcouncil.hint.admin_remove: This candidacy will be removed from the election. The player may still vote if they remain on the electoral roll.
message.realmcouncil.blocks_received: Blocks delivered. A full inventory drops them at your feet.
notification.realmcouncil.winner: %s won the election for %s. The oath desk awaits.
notification.realmcouncil.phase.nominati: Nominations are open for %s. Visit the election noticeboard.
notification.realmcouncil.phase.campaign: The campaign for %s has started. Read the candidates’ proposals.
notification.realmcouncil.phase.voting: Voting is open for %s. Cast your secret vote at a ballot box.
notification.realmcouncil.phase.runoff: %s is tied. Runoff round %s is open at the ballot box.
notification.realmcouncil.phase.finished: The election for %s ended without a winner. Consult the public results.
notification.realmcouncil.candidacy_save: Your candidacy and proposals were saved.
notification.realmcouncil.vote_sealed: Your secret vote was sealed. You may vote once per round.
notification.realmcouncil.decision_publi: %s published a new government decision. Read it at the noticeboard.
